chunks: Prepare yourselves, may Allah have mercy on you!

For the call for departure has been announced to you. Regard your stay in the world as short, and return with the best of the provision that is with you, because surely, in front of you lies a difficult valley, and places of stay full of fear and awe. You must reach them and stay in them.

And know that the eyes of death are approaching towards you, and it is as though you are in its talons and it has struck itself against you. Difficult affairs and distressing dangers have crushed you into it.
So cut away all the attachments of this world, and assist yourselves with the provision of God's fear.
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali advise believers to prepare for death and the afterlife?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) employs the metaphor of a traveler preparing for a perilous journey to urge believers to sever attachments to the world and accumulate piety as their spiritual provision. This exhortation highlights the inevitability of death and the need for readiness, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *zuhd* (asceticism) and *taqwa* (God-consciousness) as essential for navigating the trials of the grave and the Day of Judgment.

en.sayed-ali-raza: May Allāh have mercy on you!

Provide yourselves for the journey because the call for departure has been announced. Regard your stay in the world as very short, and return (to Allāh) with the best provision that is with you, because surely, in front of you lies a valley, difficult to climb, and places of stay full of fear and dangers. You have to reach there and stay in them.

And know that the eyes of death are approaching towards you. It is as though you are (already) in its talons and it has struck itself against you. Difficult affairs and distressing dangers have crushed you into it.
You should therefore cut away all the attachments of this world and assist yourselves with the provision of Allāh’s fear.
